title: Haye Sajjad Ne Ghum, Kaise Uthaaye Hongay
body:
Log Bazar Main, Zainab Ko Jo Laaye Hongay
1- Yaad Abbas Ki Zainab, Ko Satati Hogi
Log Khayam Ko, Jab Lootnay Aaye Hongay
2- Chor Kar Kufa Ko Haye She,r-e Nabi Main Haider
Paak Sajjad Ke, Taboot Pe Aaye Hongay
3- Jab Nabi Zaadiyan Darba,ar Main Sar Nangay Gayi
Khoon Beemar Ki, Aankhon Ne Bahaye Hongay
4- Bheer Bhi Aam Thi Haaye Sar Pe, Ridaen Bhi Na Thi
Kaise Namoos Ne, Phir Chehre Chupaaye Hongay
